# netbox_users (Data Source)

Lists user objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_users" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: date_joined, date_joined__empty, date_joined__gt, date_joined__gte, date_joined__lt, date_joined__lte, date_joined__n, email, email__empty, email__ic, email__ie, email__iew, email__iregex, email__isw, email__n, email__nic, email__nie, email__niew, email__nisw, email__regex, first_name, first_name__empty, first_name__ic, first_name__ie, first_name__iew, first_name__iregex, first_name__isw, first_name__n, first_name__nic, first_name__nie, first_name__niew, first_name__nisw, first_name__regex, group, group__n, group_id, group_id__n, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, is_active, is_superuser, last_login, last_login__empty, last_login__gt, last_login__gte, last_login__lt, last_login__lte, last_login__n, last_name, last_name__empty, last_name__ic, last_name__ie, last_name__iew, last_name__iregex, last_name__isw, last_name__n, last_name__nic, last_name__nie, last_name__niew, last_name__nisw, last_name__regex, notification_group_id, notification_group_id__n, owner, owner__n, owner_id, owner_id__n, permission_id, permission_id__n, q, username, username__empty, username__ic, username__ie, username__iew, username__iregex, username__isw, username__n, username__nic, username__nie, username__niew, username__nisw, username__regex. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) The matching users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of is_active.
- `date_joined` (String) When the account was created.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `first_name` (String)
- `group_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the groups the user belongs to.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the user may log in.
- `last_login` (String) When the user last logged in; null until the first login.
- `last_name` (String)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the user. Never returned by NetBox, so changes made outside Terraform go unnoticed.
- `url` (String)
- `username` (String)
